summary: The pinned 58/31/27 counts, byte total, MP3 header checks, budget numbers, and API and test coverage check out and leave no build decision open. One contradiction blocks Green: plan Phase 1 T2 asks for an event-map header comment that AC1 and the T1 cases forbid. The monorepo target path cannot be verified from this repo and needs confirmation at hand-off.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] plan.md Phase 1 T2 / spec.md AC1: The event-map header comment that T2 requires conflicts with AC1 (58 rows and no other row), T1 case 1 (line 1 is exactly the header), and T1 cases 2-3 (three fields per line, exactly 58 rows), so Green cannot write a file that passes Red while following the Green instruction. Rationale: Comment placement and parser behavior are a schema choice left to the implementer, and no test case says comment lines are skipped.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] spec.md Decision d / AC6: The monorepo target apps/advantage-games/public/audio/chibi/ cannot be verified from this repo; grep finds it only in this track's spec.md and plan.md, docs/apk-port.md:238 documents only apps/advantage-games/public/packs/, and the local monorepo has no audio/chibi folder. Rationale: The hand-off MANIFEST records this path as the delivery target, so an unverified path can misroute the folder; the PM or Monorepo session must confirm it at hand-off. The PM decision itself is not reopened.

F3 [Nit] spec.md Context / Exclusions: The claim of 22 synthesized moods does not match the code; src/ holds 26 distinct mood names (3 built-in in BUILT_IN_MOODS and 23 defineMood names). Rationale: This is record drift in a pinned count, but music stays out of scope, so the build does not change.

F4 [Nit] spec.md Context: The claim that no file in src/ or demo/ loads an .mp3 is false; demo/public/stories/*/story.json reference article.mp3 and words.mp3. Rationale: The intent is game sound effects, so narrowing the wording to game audio files removes the contradiction without changing the build.

F5 [Nit] plan.md Phase 2 T4: The render command omits the heavy-run route that measure/archive/chore_earshot_sounds_20261121/spec.md D8 pins for every render. Rationale: The cold render takes about 69 s, so the same HEAVY_MIN_AVAIL_MB=1500 heavy-run.sh wrapper should be named; output does not change.

paraphrase.proposes: The track maps the 58 game effect names to the seven earshot set entries or to synth. It adds an MP3 copy of each Ogg through a pinned ffmpeg command and picks Ogg or MP3 once per browser with canPlayType. The AudioBus plays a file when one is decoded and falls back to the synth recipe on a missing mapping or a failed load. A preload budget and a manifest hand-off folder send the files to the PM for the monorepo, while credits stay deferred and the moods stay synthesized.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, each game names its effects and the AudioBus builds every effect from tones and noise, so no game file loads an audio file today. The sound-set wrapper renders seven Ogg files from sounds/sets/chibi.json into sounds/chibi/, and the files total 90,468 bytes. The bus synthesizes all moods, and the hand-off folder and MP3 copy do not exist yet.
